::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Decr 30th [1861]  
**From:** Otterbourn  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell/Cobweb-4
:::

My dear [Cobweb](people/person_675.qmd),

I am glad to tell you that no one has passed you, though [Firefly](people/person_1168.qmd) is your equal, in the number of votes, and I therefore should like to know which of [Mother Goose](organizations/other_104.qmd)’s works you would like best to have- only do not expect it immediately as I should like to have it bound for you.

Thank you for letting me see the photograph I am glad you have got it as it is much better than the only one I have now to give away The broken negative was not quite so good as this.

[Humble Bee](people/person_81.qmd), [Irene](people/person_538.qmd) and Stormy Petrel[^1] are the three best this time

your affectionate

Mother Goose

---

[^1]: Stormy Petrel, or Petrel, was a member of the Gosling Society, but her identity is uncertain.
